title: docs: update README — 2026-08-26
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt: Daily README update: Latest News and star history. Recent Apps is refreshed when an app is published.

gist.headline: Fresh hive bulletin
gist.blurb: The README's little news garden got its daily tending. Fresh project news, refreshed app sightings, and a newly plotted star trail are all in place.
gist.summary: Refreshed the README's Latest News and star-history charts, with Recent Apps continuing to update whenever a new app is published.
gist.impact: Visitors to the repository get a current snapshot of project activity, community apps, and GitHub star growth without digging through old pollen.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy open-source bulletin board in a garden shed: Polli updates a pixel README page with a gently rising star chart and pinned app postcards, surrounded by flowering code-plants. The scene represents the repository as a living community noticeboard rather than a corporate dashboard.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink blush, light blue wings, and a tiny editor's visor, pinning fresh app postcards beside a rising star chart on a retro glowing README bulletin board; code-flowers and vines grow around it. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, with small pixel-font text: 'LATEST NEWS'. Nostalgic but beautiful, emotionally warm.
